title: List Counting Failures Are Not One Phenomenon
abstract: arXiv:2609.22230v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Counting the items in a bracketed list looks trivial, yet open-weight chat models often get it wrong. Prior work usually blames input bottlenecks such as subword fragmentation or attention dilution, which predict that different models should fail in roughly the same way. Across seven instruct models on identical prompts, however, wrong answers form distinct modes: Qwen and Gemma 27B often flip odd lengths to a nearby even integer, OLMo concentrates errors on a few mid-sized integers, and Llama tends to under-count. These modes are useful labels rather than a stable family law (Gemma 9B does not reproduce Gemma 27B's odd-to-even drop), and heavier subword fragmentation does not make counting harder on our benchmark. When the model answers incorrectly, a linear probe can usually still recover the true count from the residual stream. Matching the same odd-to-even error also does not imply the same late-MLP magnitude fix: scaling a late MLP

translated_title: 列表计数失败并非单一现象
translated_abstract: 计算括号列表中的项目数量看似简单，但开源权重聊天模型却经常出错。先前的工作通常将原因归咎于输入瓶颈，例如子词切分碎片化或注意力稀释，这些解释预测不同模型应以大致相同的方式失败。然而，在相同提示下对七个指令模型进行测试后发现，错误答案呈现出不同的模式：Qwen 和 Gemma 27B 经常将奇数长度翻转为邻近的偶数，OLMo 将错误集中在几个中等大小的整数上，而 Llama 则倾向于少计数。这些模式是有用的标签，而非稳定的家族规律（Gemma 9B 并未重现 Gemma 27B 的奇数转偶数下降），而且在我们的基准测试中，更严重的子词碎片化并没有使计数变得更难。当模型回答错误时，线性探针通常仍能从残差流中恢复真实的计数。匹配相同的奇数转偶数错误也并不意味着相同的后期 MLP 幅度修复：缩放后期 MLP……
tldr: 该研究通过对七个指令模型的测试发现，大语言模型在列表计数上的失败并非由子词碎片化等单一输入瓶颈导致，而是不同模型各自呈现出独特的错误模式，且模型内部通常仍保留着正确的计数信息。
en_tdlr: Testing seven instruct models reveals that LLM list counting failures are not a single phenomenon—different models exhibit distinct error modes not explained by input bottlenecks like subword fragmentation, and the true count is often still recoverable from the residual stream.
